bio.name: Architect Gianluca Pignataro
bio.intro: Born in Bologna, where I completed my secondary education in the sciences, I graduated in Florence before beginning my architectural career in Cagliari. At the practice of Prof. Giovanni Maria Campus, I worked on architectural design and the restoration and refurbishment of historic buildings. Over thirty years in practice, I have developed particular expertise in this field through commissions including the refurbishment of seven buildings in Baunei’s historic centre for Stams s.r.l., part of the Cualbu Group. My architectural work in Italy includes projects for Findomestic Banca, building contractors, housing cooperatives and private clients. As a dual Italian and US citizen, I have also delivered five retail units in shopping centres and a villa in Puerto Rico (USA).

titolare.title: 1. Data controller
titolare.content: The controller of personal data is Architect Gianluca Pignataro, based at {studio}, VAT number: {vatNumber}, Email: {email}

tipologie.title: 2. Types of data collected
tipologie.content: This website collects certain personal data from users. These may include:

items.0: Browsing data: IP address, browser type, operating system, pages visited
items.1: Voluntarily provided data: information sent voluntarily by email or communicated to the practice by telephone
items.2: Local preferences: choices concerning optional services and the status of introductory screens, stored in the browser
items.3: Google Maps: technical data communicated to Google only when you authorise the map on the Contact page

finalita.title: 3. Purposes of processing
finalita.content: Personal data are processed for the following purposes:

items.1: Responding to enquiries about architectural services
items.2: Displaying the optional map with prior consent
items.3: Keeping the website secure and operational
items.4: Compliance with legal and tax obligations

base-giuridica.title: 4. Legal basis for processing
base-giuridica.content: The optional map is activated with the data subject’s consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR), which can be withdrawn through “Cookie preferences” in the footer. Enquiries about architectural services are processed to take pre-contractual steps or provide the requested service (point (b)); statutory obligations are based on point (c). The security and operation of the website serve the legitimate interest in providing it (point (f)).

conservazione.title: 5. Data retention
conservazione.content: Personal data are retained only for as long as strictly necessary to achieve the purposes for which they were collected:

items.0: Contact data: for as long as necessary to handle the request and meet any contractual or statutory obligations
items.1: Optional service preferences: valid for 365 days; introductory screen status: browser tab session
items.2: Technical hosting and Google Maps data: according to the retention periods and terms of the respective providers

content.0: Hosting is provided by Vercel, which receives the technical data needed to respond to browser requests. See Vercel’s privacy policy for the processing carried out by the provider.
content.1: Google Maps remains blocked until consent is given. Once activated, Google’s privacy terms also apply, including information about recipients and international transfers. Deactivation removes the map without deleting data already received by Google.
content.2: Links to external websites and social media are opened only when you choose to follow them; the privacy policies of the websites visited apply.

diritti.title: 6. Rights of the data subject
diritti.content: The data subject has the right to obtain the following from the controller:

items.1: Rectification or erasure of their data

reclami.title: 7. Complaints
reclami.content: Data subjects have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (www.gpdp.it) if they believe that processing concerning them infringes the Regulation.

modifiche.title: 8. Changes to the Privacy Policy
modifiche.content: This Privacy Policy may be amended periodically. Changes will be published on this page, together with the date of the latest update.

cosa-sono.title: 1. Cookies and browser storage
cosa-sono.content: Cookies and local browser storage allow information to be stored on your device. This website uses localStorage to remember your choice about optional services and sessionStorage to manage introductory screens during your visit.

tipologie.title: 2. Tools used by the website
tipologie.content: Navigation preferences are stored on your device. The website does not integrate Google Analytics or marketing tools; fonts and icons are served by the website, without connections to Google Fonts or the FontAwesome CDN.

content.0: The Contact page can display a map provided by Google Maps. The map remains disabled until you choose “Accept optional services”. Once activated, the browser connects to Google and communicates technical data such as your IP address and device information; Google may use its own cookies and storage tools according to its settings. For details, see Google’s privacy policy.

gestione.title: 4. Managing preferences
gestione.content: The “Cookie preferences” button in the footer, also available on mobile, allows you to change your choice at any time. “Necessary only” prevents the map from loading and removes any map that is already open. Withdrawal stops new map connections but does not delete data already received by Google or third-party cookies: these can be removed in your browser settings.

consenso.title: 5. Duration of your choice
consenso.content: Your choice is recorded with the date and remains valid for 365 days, after which you are asked again. A choice without a valid date is considered expired. Browsing or scrolling the page does not authorise optional services. If your browser prevents storage, your choice applies only during the current visit.

dettaglio.title: 6. Local storage used
dettaglio.content: These entries are local browser storage, not cookies sent to the server. You can delete them in your browser settings.
